description: Regression cases for the 27 Oct brief 'Autonomous final reliability' (Phase 2), written from the stored pages before the fixes and kept apart from the existing sets, whose expectations are unchanged: citizens abroad (by country, region, lower case) versus residents (by city), voter address changes, lower-case abbreviations, and a document asked about as a requirement (page 17 lists it) versus how to obtain it (no stored page). Identification only ("answer": null). Page 21: overseas electors are citizens absent from the country owing to employment, education etc.; page 19: Form 8 for shifting of residence.
